architecture.agentAction: AgentTurnResult has a third mutually exclusive action category, AgentWorkingSetTransitionProposal, beside external Tool calls and Run conclusion
architecture.agentChoice: the Agent proposal names the exact already-known successor pins, next attempt identity and bounded basis; Harness does not rank, discover, summarize or repair that selection
architecture.atomicAdmission: SQLiteHarnessRunContinuityStore applies one accepted proposal as an atomic replan/select/commit WorkingSet transaction under one Run lease
architecture.providerNormalization: DeepSeek may encode the cognition action with function-calling, but DeepSeekTurnAdapter normalizes it to WorkingSet cognition rather than AgentToolCall/Runtime effect
architecture.projection: after admission, the existing mature WorkingSetViewProjector makes the newly committed successor the exact next Provider view

behavior.deepSeekEndToEnd: mocked DeepSeek wire turn 1 emits a WorkingSet transition from A to exact source B; mature OrdivonAgentLoop admits it and the second DeepSeek request contains B rather than A before concluding
behavior.notATool: the end-to-end cognition transition succeeds with Contract and execution maxToolCalls equal to zero and Run toolCalls remains zero
behavior.singleActionLaw: normalized model turns must choose exactly one of WorkingSet transition, external Tool calls, or conclusion; DeepSeek cognition plus an external Tool in one turn is rejected before ToolBridge execution
behavior.concurrency: two independent workers racing different successor proposals from the same WorkingView produce one complete three-event successor transaction and one rejected branch, with no partial losing replan
behavior.idempotency: exact transition replay from a fresh SQLite Store/Continuity instance returns the already committed successor and appends no additional cognition events
behavior.responseLoss: when Provider turn 1 durably completes with a WorkingSet proposal but its in-process return is lost, a fresh Loop replays that result, admits B, and physically dispatches only turn 2; turn 1 is not redispatched
behavior.doctor: mechanically valid WorkingSet history carrying a forged transition proposal basis passes low-level Store Doctor but fails Continuity Doctor semantic transition validation
behavior.privacy: durable Agent-owned WorkingSet transition requires model-content retention authority; metadata-only is not silently promoted to retain cognition content

conclusion: P-C1.3 establishes the first Agent-owned cognition-state transition in the mature Harness path: an Agent can choose an exact successor WorkingSet from the WorkingView it actually saw, and Harness can validate, atomically persist, replay and concurrency-fence that choice without treating cognition as a Runtime Tool or selecting Context on the Agent's behalf.
knownLimits: P-C1.3 does not provide Context discovery, search, ranking, RAG, Memory, summarization, evidence-sufficiency policy or an automatic Context scheduler. The exact source identities in a proposal must already be known to the Agent.

The initial committed WorkingSet that gives the Agent its first WorkingView is still seeded by caller/domain integration; this slice proves Agent ownership of successor transitions, not autonomous bootstrap discovery.

Harness validates proposal identity, predecessor view, source existence/privacy, revision law and concurrency, but it does not judge whether the Agent's selected pins or textual basis are epistemically good choices.

Durable WorkingSet transition currently requires model-content retention authority. Metadata-only can use ephemeral WorkingView projection but cannot persist an Agent-owned successor without explicit retained-content authority.
Malformed or mixed DeepSeek cognition actions currently fail closed at Adapter/Loop admission rather than entering a dedicated model-correctable cognition-repair protocol.

AgentWorkingSetTransitionProposal is available from ordivon_harness.core for caller-neutral integration, while WorkingViewProjector, transition handler wiring and the DeepSeek transition switch remain outside the recommended ordivon_harness.api facade.

The experiments use deterministic/mock Provider transport to prove the complete Provider-wire normalization and mature execution path; they do not claim a particular model will reliably discover or choose good Context without further experiments.
